compounding.basis: engine-computed, 5y Dhan archive 2021-01-01 to 2026-08-31, account Rs 1,00,000, ladder capital Rs 1,00,000, cap 20 lots
compounding.why_engine: An earlier estimate divided a finished book's P&L by its lot count to get a per-lot series. That is only valid if fees scale with lots; brokerage is a flat Rs 80 per order, so a 578-trade PE book divided that way implied lot counts of 1.01, 1.03 and 2.97 instead of 1 and 3. Every figure here is produced by the engine sizing and charging each trade.

pair.label: CE and PE together, one account, both laddered, 4 lots
pair.note: Each book falls harder alone than the pair does together: CE -20.7%, PE -59.1%, pair -15.3%. They lose in different months.

running_now.note: Half the documented size, for the first few months. The rules and the ladder are identical; only the base lot count differs.

compounding.basis_note: Every row: 4 lots, from Rs 2,00,000, Dhan archive, all charges applied.

source_comparison.finding: The archives agree on calls to within Rs 152 across two years. The gap is the put book, and almost all of it is 2025; 2026 agrees to within Rs 1,195.

pe.exit_rule: close crosses S1, S2, S3, S4, S5 either way, close crosses TC (up), the 20% leg stop, or 15:10

capital_profile.basis: measured from the engine: entry premium x quantity on every trade, 5y Dhan, overlapping trades summed

live.label: as deployed — 2 lots, 3 on expiry, ladder on

capital_profile.note: The two books never hold a position at the same moment -- 48 shared days in five years, zero overlap -- so the account carries the larger of the two, not the sum. The peak is not a starting requirement: a laddered book only reaches it after banking its way there, and the engine's own capital check counts banked profit as fundable. Starting at 2 lots the median trade ties up about Rs 28,600.

deployed.basis: 4 lots, 5 on expiry, CE ladder +25% and PE ladder +75% of Rs 2,00,000, capped at 20; Dhan archive 2021-01-01 to 2026-08-31; every statutory charge and 10/14 bps slippage applied to every trade; exits checked on each 5-minute close, as the live engine checks them

slip_basis.describes: the deployed configuration: 4 lots, 5 on expiry, both ladders, Dhan prices
slip_basis.note: Re-run on the deployed configuration; the same slippage is applied to entry and exit.
